name: powerbi-desktop
description: AI-assisted local Power BI Desktop workbench for live Desktop model review, DAX validation, metadata governance, fix backlogs, DAX fix drafts, discovery, documentation, configurable governance, dependency graphs, AI prompt packs, PBIP/TMDL workflows, refactoring plans, and report blueprints.

interface.shortDescription: AI workbench for local Power BI Desktop projects.
interface.longDescription: Adds an AI-assisted Power BI Desktop workbench for local projects and open Desktop sessions: live XMLA/ADOMD model discovery, environment discovery, PBIX/PBIT/PBIP inventory, PBIP structure analysis, text-model documentation, configurable DAX and Power Query governance rules, dependency graphs, AI prompt packs, governance scoring, semantic metric catalogs, report UX blueprints, and safe PBIP/TMDL refactoring guidance.
defaultPrompt: Inventory this folder for PBIX and PBIT files and summarize what can be inspected safely.
Help me document the DAX measures and Power Query transformations in this Power BI project.
Run a Power BI insight scan and identify DAX risks, model smells, and the safest next actions.
Create a governed PBIP/TMDL refactoring plan for this report.
Generate a metric catalog and semantic contract for this Power BI model.
Create a report UX blueprint from the metric catalog and model summary.
Create an AI prompt pack for reviewing and improving this Power BI project.
Run a full AI review package for this Power BI project.
Inspect the currently open Power BI Desktop model.
